top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes an enabling physical invention: controlling trapping-induced differential shifts lets confined atoms supply a useful optical frequency reference. The Katori–Ye conception-and-realization allocation and narrow citation are coherent, although original oscillator contributions and independent systematic budgets remain to be established; neither precision records nor the number of supporters proves priority. Original transmission-microscopy correction is my closest alternative for removing a definite measurement barrier. QSH and DMFT are substantial fundamental discoveries, while the KPZ theory-and-confirmation allocation carries a particularly explicit unresolved original-author question. These are genuine award cases, so I place no award last.
